answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the garden of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, diluted when peers disagree, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Work waits on the canyon until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ivory of the next round.
